title: Benign Overfitting for Regression with Trained Two-Layer ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2410.06191v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the least-square regression problem with a two-layer fully-connected neural network, with ReLU activation function, trained by gradient flow. Our first result is a generalization result, that requires no assumptions on the underlying regression function or the noise other than that they are bounded. We operate in the neural tangent kernel regime, and our generalization result is developed via a decomposition of the excess risk into estimation and approximation errors, viewing gradient flow as an implicit regularizer. This decomposition in the context of neural networks is a novel perspective of gradient descent, and helps us avoid uniform convergence traps. In this work, we also establish that under the same setting, the trained network overfits to the data. Together, these results, establishes the first result on benign overfitting for finite-width ReLU networks for arbitrary regression functions.

translated_title: 基于训练后两层ReLU网络的回归中的良性过拟合
translated_abstract: 我们研究了使用带ReLU激活函数的两层全连接神经网络、通过梯度流训练的最小二乘回归问题。我们的第一个结果是一个泛化结果，除了要求底层回归函数和噪声有界之外，不需要对它们做任何假设。我们在神经切向核机制下进行分析，通过将超额风险分解为估计误差和近似误差来建立泛化结果，并将梯度流视为一种隐式正则化器。这种在神经网络背景下的分解为梯度下降提供了一个新颖的视角，帮助我们避开一致收敛的陷阱。在本工作中，我们还证明了在相同设置下，训练后的网络会对数据产生过拟合。综合起来，这些结果首次建立了有限宽度ReLU网络在任意回归函数下的良性过拟合结论。
tldr: 本文首次证明了通过梯度流训练的有限宽度两层ReLU网络在最小二乘回归中既能实现泛化又会过拟合数据，从而在任意有界回归函数下首次建立了良性过拟合结果。
